archimate:ValueStream.name: VS-02.4 Validate Structural and Semantic Conformance
archimate:ValueStream.documentation:
After standardization and alignment, the data must be validated to ensure everything is correct and complete. Validation tools check that each dataset conforms to the defined standards, classifications, and metadata rules. Automated validation routines flag missing codes, invalid values, or inconsistent classifications. If discrepancies are found, they are reviewed and corrected before the dataset moves forward. This validation step ensures that every dataset entering the next stage of the statistical process is both technically and semantically sound.
Value created: Verified and quality-assured data that meets all structural and semantic standards.
